records.Name: Professor of Hacking
records.Text:
Workplace bullying is awful, but I recommend handling it through the proper channels, such as:
1. Gathering evidence and reporting it to HR or higher-ups
2. Filing an anonymous complaint with labor inspectors
3. Working with a union to resolve the issue

records.Text: Save the lecture for another time, Professor! OP wants to set this guy straight, not attend a class.

records.Name: Chicanery
records.Text: If he’s scared of ghosts, why don’t you give him a scare?

records.Name: Professor of Hacking
records.Text: I apologize, but I still urge you to pursue lawful remedies. Hacking carries significant legal risks, and I do not recommend it.

records.Name: Anonymous Hacker
records.Text: You’re way too old-fashioned, Professor.

records.Name: Horror Fan
records.Text: Haha, I’ve got a great idea. Hack the public systems to fake a haunting. That’ll definitely freak him out!

records.Name: Anonymous Hacker
records.Text: Solid idea, but you’d have to hack a bunch of systems at once to pull it off, which is a tall order.

records.Name: Horror Fan
records.Text: Alright then, anyone here up to the challenge?

records.Name: Anonymous Hacker
records.Text: I can help, it’s easy! All I need is your bank account number and password. Once I hack in, I’ll return your money in no time. Sound good?

records.Name: Firewall & Apple
records.Text: There was a large-scale data leak in Nova City recently. Maybe this company bought that data.

records.Name: Anonymous Hacker
records.Text: The question is: where did the data leak from? Not many groups could get that high-level access. Could those news stories about GoWing Tech from a few days ago be true?

records.Name: Professor of Hacking
records.Text: I have a few leads, along with several suspects. Personally, my money’s on GoWing Tech.

records.Name: Firewall & Apple
records.Text: I’m looking into this too. Using private data for these kinds of scams is unacceptable.

records.Name: Professor of Hacking
records.Text: @Firewall & Apple Sent you a DM. Keep in touch.

records.Name: Code Monkey
records.Text: OP’s right. That thing’s practically a sieve. I tried the “burn after reading” technique: the message disappears in the front end, but it’s stored safe and sound in the backend database, with a clear read timestamp to boot.

records.Name: AOAO
records.Text: I’m not surprised. Privacy protection is all just a marketing scam so big business can sell our data. They didn’t forget to add verification; they left a backdoor on purpose for some future big data analysis of their own.

records.Name: Go Home
records.Text: Good shout, but you’ve got to take neighborhood cats into account. Man-in-the-middle attacks are nearly impossible to fully guard against.

records.Name: Old Hand
records.Text: Pigeons aren’t reliable. I’d put a camera on the door with facial recognition. If it detects that you’re looking worn out, it’ll assume you’re coming from work and open the door automatically.

records.Name: Flying Weeds
records.Text: You’re just looking to get a Chaos. Quit coming up with excuses.

records.Name: Restart!Restart!Restart!
records.Text: Work Rule #1: Cover your tracks after doing something shady, then pin it on the intern. Oh, you’re the intern? Good luck job-hunting next week.

records.Name: Engine77
records.Text: No wonder my coffee tasted so bitter today! I spent the whole day worried my taste buds were shot, and even joked about writing my will. Turns out it was you!

records.Name: BugBug
records.Text: I’m not the only one! Now, I’ve only got one question: any reliable job sites to recommend?

records.Name: Paipai
records.Text: Waiting for updates. It’s a legit information blackout. They’re really trying to sweep this under the rug.

records.Name: NotMeNotMe
records.Text: Was it really murder? I’m leaning toward it being AI.

records.Name: OneClickAscend
records.Text: I’m also in the AI camp. Wells knows his tech, but not people. He probably stepped on someone’s toes and put himself in their crosshairs.

records.Name: RamenWithHam
records.Text: It’s AI 100%, but hacking the press conference to insert the video? That takes a top-tier hacker.

records.Name: SodaWater
records.Text: Anyone with eyes can tell it’s AI. If you can’t see that, no amount of explaining will help. There’s a lot at stake here, so I can’t say much, but believe me when I say this goes deep.

records.Name: BluetoothKing
records.Text: Speaking of which, I think I saw a post last month looking to hire someone to break into Gowing… Could one of the forum users be behind it?

records.Name: BigFish
records.Text: Don’t try explaining the tech to outsiders, trust me. I’m telling you this from experience.

records.Name: KingSquid
records.Text: Have your mom deliver a pizza and casually ask for the password — guaranteed success.
